description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of configurations for a custom field of a [type](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/manifest-reference/modules/jira-custom-field-type/) created by a [Forge app](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/).

The result can be filtered by one of these criteria:

 *  `id`.
 *  `fieldContextId`.
 *  `issueId`.
 *  `projectKeyOrId` and `issueTypeId`.

Otherwise, all configurations are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg). Jira permissions are not required for the Forge app that provided the custom field type.

parameters.description: The ID or key of the custom field, for example `customfield_10000`.
parameters.name: fieldIdOrKey

parameters.description: The list of configuration IDs. To include multiple configurations, separate IDs with an ampersand: `id=10000&id=10001`. Can't be provided with `fieldContextId`, `issueId`, `projectKeyOrId`, or `issueTypeId`.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: The list of field context IDs. To include multiple field contexts, separate IDs with an ampersand: `fieldContextId=10000&fieldContextId=10001`. Can't be provided with `id`, `issueId`, `projectKeyOrId`, or `issueTypeId`.
parameters.name: fieldContextId

parameters.description: The ID of the issue to filter results by. If the issue doesn't exist, an empty list is returned. Can't be provided with `projectKeyOrId`, or `issueTypeId`.
parameters.name: issueId

parameters.description: The ID or key of the project to filter results by. Must be provided with `issueTypeId`. Can't be provided with `issueId`.
parameters.name: projectKeyOrId

parameters.description: The ID of the issue type to filter results by. Must be provided with `projectKeyOrId`. Can't be provided with `issueId`.
parameters.name: issueTypeId

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user is not a Jira admin or the request is not authenticated as from the app that provided the field.

404.description: Returned if the custom field is not found.
